title: Make absence a deliberate place inside the sentence

motion.summary: The phrase builds around an empty bracketed center; YIELD HER stays on the left while STRENGTH appears isolated at the lower right.
phases: Establish an empty central area before any text.
Build the setup above and left of that vacancy.
Place the withheld concept apart from the sentence rather than filling the center.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Let a missing connection or inaccessible area carry the meaning of deprivation.
variations: Represent the void as an empty chair, missing building block or unlit window.
In a restoration scene, let the isolated element return to close the gap.
Use a newly designed asymmetric composition rather than repeating the corner-bracket motif.
cautions: A meaningful gap still needs a clear reading order.
Avoid so much empty space that the lyric looks accidentally misaligned.
Keep the withheld word large enough on mobile; do not rely only on red color.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: The isolated red noun makes the emotional object easy to locate.
The otherwise restrained composition gives the vacancy visual importance.
limitations: The corner marks are extremely faint.
The visual effect is chiefly composition and staged text arrival, not complex continuous animation.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
